description: Splits the signal into four bands, distorts each one on its own, and adds them back together

params.text: Sets one of the three crossover frequencies the four bands are split at
Sets the resonance of that band's filter
Sets how hard that band is driven into the distortion, 1 to 10
Picks the distortion that band is given, stepping through three curves
Switches that band's volume between before and after the distortion
Sets how much of that band is in the output

inputs.text: The signal being split into bands
Volts here are added to that crossover frequency
Volts here are added to that band's resonance
Volts here are added to that band's drive
Volts here step that band's distortion on through the three curves
Volts here flip that band between taking its volume before and after the distortion
Volts here are added to that band's level

outputs.text: The four bands added back together

inputs.16: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.17: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.18: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
